kind: Derived summary of original, unmodified WorldOps evidence
scope: Six native scenes, all seasons, active UI, real placement replay, menu and four labelled distant diagnostic views in both orientations. Not an all-100 native visual review or mobile FPS measurement.

levels.observation: Spring: continuous broad meadow tones, stable tent/stump/rock contact in both views and menu; four distant regions share the same finish. The pre-existing mug support declaration and clipped primary landmark remain unresolved.

Spring slope: coherent ground through the surrounding terrain; tree roots, shed, bench, stones and tents read against the surface. Source offsets are preserved. Mug support declaration and landmark clipping remain unresolved.

Summer river scene: ground finish and near-surface occlusion remain coherent through gameplay, menu and distant views. Bridge/landmark support findings, one aquatic plant and landmark framing remain unresolved.

Heavy summer wreck scene: former granular ground and scattered brown soil pyramids are removed. Rock, stump, tent bases and awning feet have local contact shading without additional surfaces; the complete scene budget passes. Existing pot/mug/awning support findings and clipped landmarks remain unresolved.

Autumn rain: subdued wet soil/meadow transitions stay continuous, with readable stone, stump, bench and tent contact under overcast light. No terrain-root drift is visible in the four distant diagnostics. Existing primary support, aquatic plants and landmark clipping remain unresolved.

Winter: snow cover and seasonal story are retained, with local contact at tent bases, fence, stumps and rocks. Snow transitions retain their existing broad patch treatment. Landmark clipping remains unresolved.
